# 10X

> 10X helps businesses that run on enquiries, appointments and follow-up capture enquiries, respond faster, book appointments and keep follow-up moving. Core idea: your leads don't disappear, they leak. 10X gives a business one clear workflow from first enquiry to the next step.

- Website: https://tenx.my
- Company: BTB SOLUTIONS, Malaysia
- Contact: Sales Team, admin@tenx.my
- Official call to action: Get Your Free Lead Leakage Audit (free 15-minute review, no obligation) at https://tenx.my/#audit
- Secondary call to action: Talk to Sales at https://tenx.my/#audit

## Who it is for

Businesses that rely on enquiries, appointments and follow-up, including:

- Property: agents and sales teams
- Clinics: aesthetic and dental
- Education & training: tuition centres, academies, training providers, coaches, course businesses
- Home services: aircon, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, maintenance
- Appointment businesses: beauty, wellness, fitness, consulting, professional services

## Workflow

CAPTURE → RESPOND → QUALIFY → BOOK → FOLLOW UP → REACTIVATE → CLOSE

## What it does

- Captures enquiries and gives each one an owner
- Helps the team respond, qualify and book appointments
- Keeps follow-up scheduled (for example Day 1, 3, 7 and 30)
- Brings old opportunities back into the pipeline
- An AI employee that helps with repetitive conversations, qualification and follow-up, inside rules and approvals set by the business. It supports teams and does not replace clinical or professional judgment. Exact availability depends on each customer's setup; the sales team confirms it.

## Pricing (Malaysian ringgit, per month)

Founding prices apply to the first 10 customers. WhatsApp costs are passed through at cost where applicable.

- Launch: RM427/month founding (normally RM599). Setup RM300. For teams that need a simple system for leads and follow-up.
- Growth: RM799/month founding (normally RM1,199). Setup RM500. For teams ready to automate more of the customer journey.
- Scale: from RM1,499/month founding (normally from RM1,999). Setup from RM1,000. For businesses requiring deeper workflows and custom implementation.

## Terminology

- Lead leakage: an enquiry lost because nobody replied, followed up, owned it, booked it, or could see what happened.
- Lead Leakage Audit: a free 15-minute review of how enquiries move through a business and where they break down.

## Notes for accuracy

- Product demos on the website use illustrative data and fictional names.
- 10X does not claim certifications, guaranteed results or performance statistics.
